text:
maria_cs: Heads up — CedarAI's vendor questionnaire returned with a few gaps in the DPA + SOC2 sections. Renewal check-in in 2 weeks, so we should close these before the renewal risk review. :warning:

jake_support: can you drop the link and call out the specific missing items?

maria_cs: Link: https://redwood-internal/secure/forms/cedarai-vendor-2026 (internal). Missing/unclear items: 1) Data residency clause in DPA (they selected 'multi-region' but asked about EU-only), 2) SOC2 evidence: only provided a PDF attestation, no control descriptions for encryption-at-rest or key management, 3) Subprocessor list outdated.

eli_security: :eyes: i'll take SOC2 evidence and KMS question. Maria — can you DM me the attestation they uploaded? I want to map controls -> our checklist.

maria_cs: sent the PDF to you. also pasted the DPA excerpt here:
```
DPA: Section 4.2 - Data Residency: Customer may request EU-only storage. Provider may support multi-region; additional fees may apply.
```

sam_ops: i'll set up a 30m call with their security contact tomorrow. Suggest agenda: confirm EU residency option, request detailed control descriptions for encryption and KMS, request updated subprocessor list.

dana_pm: if we can't confirm EU residency or KMS controls by renewal, we should flag renewal as "at-risk" and propose a 30-day remediation plan. cc @maria_cs for ownership.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: add vendor follow-up activity to CedarAI account (due 1734650000).

jake_support: quick q — do we have a template email for asking for SOC2 control narratives?

eli_security: yes, use /templates/security/soc2-control-request. Short bullets: specify control area, ask for evidence or control narrative, ask for cert issuer & date. I'll draft and send from security mailbox.

maria_cs: action items summary: 1) Eli — map PDF to controls + send template (in progress). 2) Sam — schedule call and invite Dana + Maria (done). 3) Jake — prepare renewal-impact note for CSM dashboard (assign risk if no answers in 48h). 4) Maria — follow up on subprocessor list and EU residency clause.

sam_ops: meeting invite sent for tomorrow 10:00 PT. link in thread.

maria_cs: thanks team. I'll update the customer record and ping legal if the DPA clause needs amendment. :thumbsup:
